reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 2300 for this 14950-receiver graph. The lower bound is an independent set of size 2300 (independent_set check true). The upper bound is a linear code M = I + 2A over F_3 with length 2300 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true), so the bracket [2300, 2300] is closed. Only one code was tried (codes_tried 1), after 2 LLM calls and 1 critic round. Of wall_s 111.483, compute_s was 89.562 and llm_s 21.921, so about 20% of the time went to the LLM. No baselines were run, so accuracy and speed cannot be compared. One caveat: the recorded hypothesis has empty params and confidence 0.6, so the family identification was never formally finalized, even though the certificate does not depend on it. own_rank is not applicable because N > 2500.
